title: The Trench
summary: Overcast, Day 96, day into night. Ironwood's quarantine sweep of Sector 4 (three 4-man fireteams, two drones, a checkpoint), the informant list, Marsh in Room 9, Carly's Switchboard at the Silver Spur, Avila's break, then the alley glimpse and the rail trench: Ruiz pinned under the MRAP door, and the freight car on the siding (freight_car_drop blocks the trench, or the Bradley rolls through and the trench fight starts).
